name: smartgen-tools – Smart Tools Generator
author: ComboInvest

sections.description:
SmartGen empowers WordPress users to create dynamic, AI-generated content with advanced AI capabilities. Users can customize prompts for various content types like titles, descriptions, and full-length stories. Key features include:

  • AI-powered tools for content generation
  • Customizable prompts for tailored content creation
  • High-quality AI integration for enhanced content results
  • Demo tool import for easy setup
  • Multisite compatibility
  • User-friendly interface with usage tracking
  • Extensive built-in documentation

Features

  • AI-Powered Content Generation: Generate titles, descriptions, articles, and more with ease.
  • Customizable Prompts: Define specific prompts for different content needs.
  • Advanced AI Integration: Leverage high-quality AI models for content creation.
  • Demo Tool Import: Set up demo tools by downloading and extracting the JSON file from the demo tools zip file, then importing it via SmartGen > Import/Export in the WordPress dashboard.
  • Multisite Compatibility: Fully compatible with WordPress multisite installations.
  • User-Friendly Interface: Intuitive dashboard to track usage and performance of tools.
  • Comprehensive Documentation: In-plugin documentation for quick guidance and troubleshooting.

External services

This plugin connects to the Google generative language API to provide AI-generated content for content generation.

  • Data sent: User input for content generation.
  • Purpose: Used to generate and return AI-powered suggestions.
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Terms of Service: https://cloud.google.com/terms

Setup Demo Tools

  1. Download the demo Tools zip file For Free by clicking here.
  2. Extract the zip file to retrieve the demo-tools.json file.
  3. In the WordPress dashboard, navigate to SmartGen > Import/Export.
  4. Select the demo-tools.json file and upload it to import the demo setup.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL-2.0-or-later license.

Support

For support, please contact sg@comboinvest.com. Our team provides 24/7 support with a response time of 12-24 hours. Support includes:
– Assistance with installation and setup
– Guidance on feature usage
– Troubleshooting and bug fixes
– Consideration of feature requests for future updates
sections.installation:
1. Upload the SmartGen plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/smartgen directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to SmartGen > Main Settings to configure your API key and plugin settings.
sections.faq:
How do I set up the API key?

Navigate to SmartGen > Main Settings and enter your API key, which you can obtain from your AI provider’s platform.

Can I customize the generated content types?

Yes, you can create and customize various content types by defining unique prompts in each Smart Tool.

Is there an import/export feature?

Yes, under the Import/Export Tools section, you can export your tools as a JSON file and import them into another WordPress site.

How do I use the shortcode for embedding tools?

To embed a tool, use the shortcode [smart_tool id="123"], replacing 123 with your tool’s ID.

How can I monitor tool usage?

The plugin’s dashboard offers an overview of tool usage statistics, with options to filter data by date.

What should I do if my tool is not generating content?

Check that your API key is active, your internet connection is stable, and that all required fields and prompts are correctly configured.
